name: Direct a multiscene work
short_description: Plan, direct, and revise a coherent work of at least ten scenes across performance, image, sound, and pacing.
self_assessment: I can direct a coherent ten-scene work without help and revise it from three audience tests.
description: Plan, direct, and revise a coherent work of at least ten scenes across performance, image, sound, and pacing. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Direct and revise a ten-scene short work
